cpt_one: Semi-logarithmic plot after an intravenous bolus: one straight line
cpt_two: Semi-logarithmic plot after an intravenous bolus: a steep early phase then a shallower straight phase
elim_rate_flat: Rate of elimination plotted against plasma concentration: a horizontal line
elim_rate_linear: Rate of elimination plotted against plasma concentration: a straight line through the origin
flipflop: One drug given as an immediate-release and an extended-release product: the tail of each curve
inf_css: Concentration during a constant-rate infusion, rising towards a plateau
inf_two_rates: Two infusion rates of the same drug, plotted together
input_types: IV bolus, oral tablet and IV infusion, each with first-order elimination
k_vs_ka: Raising k against raising ka, with the area each change gains or loses shaded
ka_k_effects: Three panels: doubling the dose, doubling the absorption rate constant, and doubling the elimination rate constant
md_bolus: Repeated IV bolus doses every 8 hours rising to a steady state between the same peak and trough
model_bolus1: One-compartment IV bolus (Module 2): the shape of the curve
model_bolus2: Two-compartment IV bolus (Module 2): the shape of the curve
model_infusion: IV infusion, one compartment (Module 3): the shape of the curve
model_intermit: Intermittent IV infusion (Module 6): the shape of the curve
model_loading: Loading dose with an infusion (Module 3): the shape of the curve
model_mdbolus: Repeated IV bolus (Module 6): the shape of the curve
model_mdoral: Multiple oral doses (Module 6a): the shape of the curve
model_oral: Single oral dose (Module 5): the shape of the curve
models_all: The eight dosing models on the same axes: how the drug goes in decides the shape
oral_peak: Concentration against time after a single oral dose, rising to a peak and then falling
oral_semilog: Concentration after a single oral dose on an axis marked 0.1, 1, 10, 100
ord_linear_curve: Concentration against time on an evenly spaced axis, falling as a curve
ord_linear_straight: Concentration against time on an evenly spaced axis, falling as a straight line
ord_semilog_curve: Concentration against time on an axis marked 1, 10, 100, 1000, bending downward
ord_semilog_straight: Concentration against time on an axis marked 1, 10, 100, 1000, falling as a straight line
rate_vs_constant: Amount in the body against time for two doses, with the rate of loss marked at three points
two_infusions: Two intermittent IV infusions: each curve on its own and their sum, read at 12 hours
